steps.message:
Route the overhead MEP of the hardest hall in the corpus, clash-free (dc_model hall_seed005_d100)

Situation

You are the MEP coordinator for a data hall — and this one is deliberately difficult. The room is ~27 × 24 m with 94 cabinets, and its 7200 mm structural grid is offset 150 mm from the floor-tile grid, so a cabinet cannot be both on-tile and clear of the columns — you must resolve that conflict the way a coordinator would. A circulation cross-aisle re-registers every cabinet row, and 104 sprinkler heads crowd the ceiling your routes must thread through. The architect has issued a seven-sheet drawing set and you must produce the coordinated 3D model: rebuild the room and its fit-out exactly as drawn, then route the three overhead services through the plenum so that nothing collides, every row is served, and the routes are as short as practical — the job a BIM coordinator does before construction, delivered as an IFC4 model built by a script.

Inputs (under input/ — seven PNG drawing sheets, nothing else)

A-101 equipment plan · A-301 building section · A-601 cabinet schedule · A-602 containment/pathway/construction data · M-101 chilled water · E-101 busway & PDU · F-101 sprinkler grid.

They behave like a real drawing set: positions on the plan, sizes in the schedule, elevations only in the section callout. No JSON side-channel, no coordinate dump. Reconcile them yourself (read them as images).

Goal

Rebuild the hall as the coordination background: racks on their floor tiles with correct facings, structural columns, CRAHs, PDUs, access floor, containment, and every sprinkler head — your routes are clash-checked against all of it.

Route three overhead services from the entries marked on M-101/E-101 — telecom cable tray, power busway, chilled-water pipe — as straight axis-aligned segments (every direction or tier change is a new segment). Tray and busway must serve every rack row; chilled water must serve every row and reach every CRAH, including the perimeter units no row header passes.

Constraints (all checked mechanically)

Zero hard clashes — one solid overlapping another by > 2 mm anywhere (a tray through a column, a pipe through a rack) fails the task. Columns run full clear height.

Connectivity — each service must form ONE connected network reaching its service entry; every row served along ≥ 80 % of its length by all three services (within 2500 mm across the row); chilled water within 2500 mm of every CRAH.

Code compliance — 2600 mm min headroom; 460 mm kept clear below every sprinkler deflector (plus the NFPA 13 obstruction rule within 450 mm below a deflector); heads required beneath runs wider than 1200 mm and beneath containment roofs; 300 mm separation between tray and busway on at least one axis; no chilled water in the 1800 mm dedicated space above a PDU; 25.4 mm pipe insulation counts in clashes. The under-floor plenum is usable for routing.

Modelling contract — IFC4 via ifcopenshell==0.8.4 (+ numpy only), millimetre project units (but placement-matrix translations in metres!), 2D profile points only, the prescribed spatial structure, exact element classes (e.g. racks = IfcFurniture/USERDEFINED/"Rack") and the required Pset_DCM_* property sets, correct facing rotations about the footprint centre. Validate with express_rules=True before submitting. The script must run headless in 300 s, deterministically, with no network and no reading the PNGs back — bake everything you read off the drawings into the script as literals.

Expected output

One self-contained Python script at output/solution.py that builds the model with ifcopenshell and writes one IFC4 file to sys.argv[1] (default output/model.ifc).

Scoring: schema gate → clash gate → connectivity gate (each 0 if failed), then score = compliance × min(1, L_opt / L_yours) — material efficiency against the reference route, discounted by code violations.

Additional requirements

In addition to the original modelling, routing, clash, connectivity and code-compliance obligations, the solver shall also produce the following design-quality data.  These items do not change the primary score; they are reported as diagnostics.

1. Achieved clearances
For every sprinkler head, compute and make available the vertical clearance from the top of each service (tray, busway, CHW) that passes under it.  For every PDU, compute the vertical clearance from the top of the PDU to the nearest CHW pipe.  For every tray-busway pair, compute the minimum separation on any axis.  The values may be stored as Pset properties on the relevant elements or simply realised by the geometry so the host grader can measure them.

2. Under-floor versus overhead length split
For each of the three services report (or make measurable from geometry) the centreline length that runs entirely below finished floor and the centreline length that runs in the overhead plenum.  The under-floor plenum remains usable; this requirement only asks that the split be visible.

3. Service elevation / tier assignment
Place every route segment so that its elevation relative to finished floor is unambiguous.  Prefer the clear-height band defined on the drawings (finished floor to the 2600 mm minimum clear height).  The grader will measure how much of each service lies inside that band, above it, or below finished floor.

4. Support / hanger elements (optional; reported when present)
If the drawings call out a maximum support spacing (for example the 1500 mm busway support limit on E-101), place support or hanger elements at intervals that respect that limit, or report the maximum unsupported span that remains.  Supports may be modelled as IfcElementAssembly or IfcBuildingElementProxy with ObjectType containing "Support" or "Hanger".

5. Service drops / terminations (optional)
In addition to the existing row-coverage obligation, provide explicit drop or termination points that bring each service to the cabinets or CRAHs it serves.  Model drops as short vertical or short horizontal segments (or as distinct elements whose ObjectType contains "Drop", "Tap" or "Termination").  The grader counts them and records their locations.

6. Drawing-note reconciliation log (optional side file)
Write a small JSON file next to the IFC (output/reconciliation.json) that lists every numeric clearance, size or spacing note extracted from the seven drawing sheets and states how it was applied (or why it could not be applied).  Example entries: "A-301 clear height 2600 mm -> enforced as headroom rule", "E-101 busway support 1500 mm max -> supports placed at 1400 mm centres".  Absence of the file is not a gate failure; its presence is reported.

All gates, the modelling contract, the runtime limit and the primary score formula remain exactly as stated above.  The additional data above are diagnostics only.

def load_png(path):
    with open(path, 'rb') as f:
        data = f.read()
    pos = 8

    while pos < len(data):
        length, ctype = struct.unpack('>I4s', data[pos:pos+8])
        cdata = data[pos+8:pos+8+length]
        if ctype == b'IHDR':
            w, h, bd, ct, comp, filt, inter = struct.unpack('>IIBBBBB', cdata)
        elif ctype == b'IDAT':
            idat.append(cdata)
        pos += 12 + length
    raw = zlib.decompress(b''.join(idat))
    bpp = 4 if ct == 6 else (3 if ct == 2 else 1)
    stride = w * bpp
    arr = np.frombuffer(raw, dtype=np.uint8).reshape(h, stride + 1)
    ftypes = arr[:, 0]
    scanlines = arr[:, 1:].astype(np.int32)
    out = np.zeros((h, stride), dtype=np.uint8)

        ft = ftypes[y]
        row = scanlines[y].copy()
        if ft == 0:
            out[y] = row

def to_braille(mask):
    # mask is boolean 2D array (H, W) where True = dark pixel
    h, w = mask.shape
    pad_h = (4 - h % 4) % 4
    pad_w = (2 - w % 2) % 2
    if pad_h or pad_w:
        mask = np.pad(mask, ((0, pad_h), (0, pad_w)), constant_values=False)
    h, w = mask.shape
    # braille dot mapping:
    # (0,0):1, (1,0):2, (2,0):4, (0,1):8, (1,1):16, (2,1):32, (3,0):64, (3,1):128
    m = mask.reshape(h // 4, 4, w // 2, 2)
    codes = (
        (m[:, 0, :, 0].astype(np.int32) << 0) |
        (m[:, 1, :, 0].astype(np.int32) << 1) |
        (m[:, 2, :, 0].astype(np.int32) << 2) |
        (m[:, 0, :, 1].astype(np.int32) << 3) |
        (m[:, 1, :, 1].astype(np.int32) << 4) |
        (m[:, 2, :, 1].astype(np.int32) << 5) |
        (m[:, 3, :, 0].astype(np.int32) << 6) |
        (m[:, 3, :, 1].astype(np.int32) << 7)
    )
    lines = []
    for row in codes:
        line = ''.join(chr(0x2800 + c) for c in row).rstrip('\u2800')
        lines.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(lines)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    im = load_png('input/A-602.png')

def to_halfblock(mask):
    h, w = mask.shape
    if h % 2 == 1:
        mask = np.pad(mask, ((0, 1), (0, 0)), constant_values=False)
        h += 1
    top = mask[0::2, :]

    chars[top & ~bot] = '▀'
    chars[~top & bot] = '▄'
    chars[top & bot] = '█'
    return '\n'.join(''.join(row).rstrip() for row in chars)

_B64_CHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_$"


def make_guid(seed_str: str) -> str:
    h = uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_DNS, f"hall_seed005_d100::{seed_str}").int
    chars = []
    for _ in range(22):
        chars.append(_B64_CHARS[h & 0x3F])
        h >>= 6
    return "".join(reversed(chars))

# IFC4 Model Builder

class HallModelBuilder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.f = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
        self._init_header_and_context()
        self.storey_elements = []

    def _init_header_and_context(self):
        f = self.f
        org = f.create_entity("IfcOrganization", Name="MEP Coordination Corp")
        app = f.create_entity(
            "IfcApplication",
            ApplicationDeveloper=org,
            Version="1.0",
            ApplicationFullName="DCM Hall Coordinator",
            ApplicationIdentifier="DCM-COORD",
        )
        person = f.create_entity("IfcPerson", FamilyName="Coordinator", GivenName="BIM")
        p_org = f.create_entity("IfcPersonAndOrganization", ThePerson=person, TheOrganization=org)
        self.owner_history = f.create_entity(
            "IfcOwnerHistory",
            OwningUser=p_org,
            OwningApplication=app,
            ChangeAction="NOCHANGE",
            CreationDate=1700000000,
        )

        # Units: MILLIMETRE
        unit_len = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="LENGTHUNIT", Prefix="MILLI", Name="METRE")
        unit_area = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="AREAUNIT", Name="SQUARE_METRE")
        unit_vol = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="VOLUMEUNIT", Name="CUBIC_METRE")
        unit_angle = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="PLANEANGLEUNIT", Name="RADIAN")
        unit_assign = f.create_entity("IfcUnitAssignment", Units=[unit_len, unit_area, unit_vol, unit_angle])

        # 3D Context & 2D Origin
        self.origin_3d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.origin_2d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_z = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
        self.dir_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_neg_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_2d_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0))

        self.world_cs = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=self.origin_3d, Axis=self.dir_z, RefDirection=self.dir_x
        )
        self.pos_2d = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement2D", Location=self.origin_2d, RefDirection=self.dir_2d_x
        )

        self.context = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Model",
            ContextType="Model",
            CoordinateSpaceDimension=3,
            Precision=1.0e-5,
            WorldCoordinateSystem=self.world_cs,
        )
        self.body_ctx = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Body",
            ContextType="Model",
            ParentContext=self.context,
            TargetView="MODEL_VIEW",
        )

        self.project = f.create_entity(
            "IfcProject",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcProject"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="hall_seed005_d100",
            Description="Data Hall Overhead MEP Coordination Model",
            RepresentationContexts=[self.context],
            UnitsInContext=unit_assign,
        )

        # Spatial Hierarchy: Project -> Site -> Building -> Storey ("Data Hall") -> Space ("Server Room")
        self.site_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=None)
        self.site = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSite",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSite"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Site",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.site_pl,
        )
        self.bldg_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.site_pl)
        self.building = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuilding",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuilding"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Building",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.bldg_pl,
        )
        self.storey_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.bldg_pl)
        self.storey = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuildingStorey",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuildingStorey::DataHall"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Hall",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            Elevation=0.0,
            ObjectPlacement=self.storey_pl,
        )
        self.space_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.storey_pl)
        self.space = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSpace",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSpace::ServerRoom"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Server Room",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            PredefinedType="INTERNAL",
            ObjectPlacement=self.space_pl,
        )

        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Project->Site"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.project,
            RelatedObjects=[self.site],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Site->Building"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.site,
            RelatedObjects=[self.building],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Building->Storey"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.building,
            RelatedObjects=[self.storey],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Storey->Space"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.storey,
            RelatedObjects=[self.space],
        )

    def make_placement(self, x: float, y: float, z: float, axis=None, ref_dir=None, parent=None):
        f = self.f
        pt = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(x), float(y), float(z)))
        ax = axis if axis is not None else self.dir_z
        rf = ref_dir if ref_dir is not None else self.dir_x
        a2p = f.create_entity("IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=pt, Axis=ax, RefDirection=rf)
        return f.create_entity("IfcLocalPlacement", PlacementRelTo=parent, RelativePlacement=a2p)

    def make_box_shape(self, x_dim: float, y_dim: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcRectangleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            XDim=float(x_dim),
            YDim=float(y_dim),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_cylinder_shape(self, radius: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcCircleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            Radius=float(radius),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_polygon_slab_shape(self, pts_2d, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        ifc_pts = [f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(px), float(py))) for px, py in pts_2d]
        ifc_pts.append(ifc_pts[0])
        poly = f.create_entity("IfcPolyline", Points=ifc_pts)
        prof = f.create_entity("IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef", ProfileType="AREA", OuterCurve=poly)
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def add_pset(self, element, pset_name: str, props_dict: dict):
        f = self.f
        prop_entities = []
        for k, v in props_dict.items():
            if isinstance(v, bool):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcBoolean", v)
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcInteger", v)
            elif isinstance(v, float):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcReal", round(float(v), 4))
            else:
                val = f.create_entity("IfcLabel", str(v))
            prop_entities.append(
                f.create_entity("IfcPropertySingleValue", Name=str(k), NominalValue=val)
            )
        pset = f.create_entity(
            "IfcPropertySet",
            GlobalId=make_guid(f"Pset::{element.GlobalId}::{pset_name}"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name=pset_name,
            HasProperties=prop_entities,
        )

class HallModelBuilder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.f = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
        self._init_header_and_context()
        self.storey_elements = []

    def _init_header_and_context(self):
        f = self.f
        org = f.create_entity("IfcOrganization", Name="MEP Coordination Corp")
        app = f.create_entity(
            "IfcApplication",
            ApplicationDeveloper=org,
            Version="1.0",
            ApplicationFullName="DCM Hall Coordinator",
            ApplicationIdentifier="DCM-COORD",
        )
        person = f.create_entity("IfcPerson", FamilyName="Coordinator", GivenName="BIM")
        p_org = f.create_entity("IfcPersonAndOrganization", ThePerson=person, TheOrganization=org)
        self.owner_history = f.create_entity(
            "IfcOwnerHistory",
            OwningUser=p_org,
            OwningApplication=app,
            ChangeAction="NOCHANGE",
            CreationDate=1700000000,
        )

        # Units: MILLIMETRE
        unit_len = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="LENGTHUNIT", Prefix="MILLI", Name="METRE")
        unit_area = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="AREAUNIT", Name="SQUARE_METRE")
        unit_vol = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="VOLUMEUNIT", Name="CUBIC_METRE")
        unit_angle = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="PLANEANGLEUNIT", Name="RADIAN")
        unit_assign = f.create_entity("IfcUnitAssignment", Units=[unit_len, unit_area, unit_vol, unit_angle])

        # 3D Context & 2D Origin
        self.origin_3d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.origin_2d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_z = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
        self.dir_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_neg_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_2d_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0))

        self.world_cs = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=self.origin_3d, Axis=self.dir_z, RefDirection=self.dir_x
        )
        self.pos_2d = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement2D", Location=self.origin_2d, RefDirection=self.dir_2d_x
        )

        self.context = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Model",
            ContextType="Model",
            CoordinateSpaceDimension=3,
            Precision=1.0e-5,
            WorldCoordinateSystem=self.world_cs,
        )
        self.body_ctx = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Body",
            ContextType="Model",
            ParentContext=self.context,
            TargetView="MODEL_VIEW",
        )

        self.project = f.create_entity(
            "IfcProject",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcProject"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="hall_seed005_d100",
            Description="Data Hall Overhead MEP Coordination Model",
            RepresentationContexts=[self.context],
            UnitsInContext=unit_assign,
        )

        # Spatial Hierarchy: Project -> Site -> Building -> Storey ("Data Hall") -> Space ("Server Room")
        self.site_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=None)
        self.site = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSite",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSite"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Site",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.site_pl,
        )
        self.bldg_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.site_pl)
        self.building = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuilding",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuilding"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Building",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.bldg_pl,
        )
        self.storey_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.bldg_pl)
        self.storey = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuildingStorey",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuildingStorey::DataHall"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Hall",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            Elevation=0.0,
            ObjectPlacement=self.storey_pl,
        )
        self.space_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.storey_pl)
        self.space = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSpace",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSpace::ServerRoom"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Server Room",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            PredefinedType="INTERNAL",
            ObjectPlacement=self.space_pl,
        )

        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Project->Site"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.project,
            RelatedObjects=[self.site],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Site->Building"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.site,
            RelatedObjects=[self.building],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Building->Storey"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.building,
            RelatedObjects=[self.storey],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Storey->Space"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.storey,
            RelatedObjects=[self.space],
        )

    def make_placement(self, x: float, y: float, z: float, axis=None, ref_dir=None, parent=None):
        f = self.f
        pt = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(x), float(y), float(z)))
        ax = axis if axis is not None else self.dir_z
        rf = ref_dir if ref_dir is not None else self.dir_x
        a2p = f.create_entity("IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=pt, Axis=ax, RefDirection=rf)
        return f.create_entity("IfcLocalPlacement", PlacementRelTo=parent, RelativePlacement=a2p)

    def make_box_shape(self, x_dim: float, y_dim: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcRectangleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            XDim=float(x_dim),
            YDim=float(y_dim),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_cylinder_shape(self, radius: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcCircleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            Radius=float(radius),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_polygon_slab_shape(self, pts_2d, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        ifc_pts = [f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(px), float(py))) for px, py in pts_2d]
        ifc_pts.append(ifc_pts[0])
        poly = f.create_entity("IfcPolyline", Points=ifc_pts)
        prof = f.create_entity("IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef", ProfileType="AREA", OuterCurve=poly)
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def add_pset(self, element, pset_name: str, props_dict: dict):
        f = self.f
        prop_entities = []
        for k, v in props_dict.items():
            if isinstance(v, bool):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcBoolean", v)
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcInteger", v)
            elif isinstance(v, float):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcReal", round(float(v), 4))
            else:
                val = f.create_entity("IfcLabel", str(v))
            prop_entities.append(
                f.create_entity("IfcPropertySingleValue", Name=str(k), NominalValue=val)
            )
        pset = f.create_entity(
            "IfcPropertySet",
            GlobalId=make_guid(f"Pset::{element.GlobalId}::{pset_name}"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name=pset_name,
            HasProperties=prop_entities,
        )

    def make_polygon_slab_shape(self, pts_2d, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        ifc_pts = [f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(px), float(py))) for px, py in pts_2d]

        poly = f.create_entity("IfcPolyline", Points=ifc_pts)

            Position=self.world_cs,

        rep = f.create_entity(

    def add_pset(self, element, pset_name: str, props_dict: dict):
        f = self.f

                val = f.create_entity("IfcBoolean", v)
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcInteger", v)
            elif isinstance(v, float):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcReal", round(float(v), 4))
            else:
                val = f.create_entity("IfcLabel", str(v))
            prop_entities.append(
                f.create_entity("IfcPropertySingleValue", Name=str(k), NominalValue=val)
            )
        pset = f.create_entity(
            "IfcPropertySet",
            GlobalId=make_guid(f"Pset::{element.GlobalId}::{pset_name}"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name=pset_name,

        )

_B64_CHARS = "0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz_$"


def make_guid(seed_str: str) -> str:
    h = uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_DNS, f"hall_seed005_d100::{seed_str}").int

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IFC4 Model Builder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class HallModelBuilder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.f = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
        self._init_header_and_context()
        self.storey_elements = []

    def _init_header_and_context(self):
        f = self.f
        org = f.create_entity("IfcOrganization", Name="MEP Coordination Corp")
        app = f.create_entity(
            "IfcApplication",
            ApplicationDeveloper=org,
            Version="1.0",
            ApplicationFullName="DCM Hall Coordinator",
            ApplicationIdentifier="DCM-COORD",
        )
        person = f.create_entity("IfcPerson", FamilyName="Coordinator", GivenName="BIM")
        p_org = f.create_entity("IfcPersonAndOrganization", ThePerson=person, TheOrganization=org)
        self.owner_history = f.create_entity(
            "IfcOwnerHistory",
            OwningUser=p_org,
            OwningApplication=app,
            ChangeAction="NOCHANGE",
            CreationDate=1700000000,
        )

        # Units: MILLIMETRE
        unit_len = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="LENGTHUNIT", Prefix="MILLI", Name="METRE")
        unit_area = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="AREAUNIT", Name="SQUARE_METRE")
        unit_vol = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="VOLUMEUNIT", Name="CUBIC_METRE")
        unit_angle = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="PLANEANGLEUNIT", Name="RADIAN")
        unit_assign = f.create_entity("IfcUnitAssignment", Units=[unit_len, unit_area, unit_vol, unit_angle])

        # 3D Context & 2D Origin
        self.origin_3d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.origin_2d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_z = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
        self.dir_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_neg_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_2d_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0))

        self.world_cs = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=self.origin_3d, Axis=self.dir_z, RefDirection=self.dir_x
        )
        self.pos_2d = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement2D", Location=self.origin_2d, RefDirection=self.dir_2d_x
        )

        self.context = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Model",
            ContextType="Model",
            CoordinateSpaceDimension=3,
            Precision=1.0e-5,
            WorldCoordinateSystem=self.world_cs,
        )
        self.body_ctx = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Body",
            ContextType="Model",
            ParentContext=self.context,
            TargetView="MODEL_VIEW",
        )

        self.project = f.create_entity(
            "IfcProject",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcProject"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="hall_seed005_d100",
            Description="Data Hall Overhead MEP Coordination Model",
            RepresentationContexts=[self.context],
            UnitsInContext=unit_assign,
        )

        # Spatial Hierarchy: Project -> Site -> Building -> Storey ("Data Hall") -> Space ("Server Room")
        self.site_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=None)
        self.site = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSite",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSite"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Site",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.site_pl,
        )
        self.bldg_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.site_pl)
        self.building = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuilding",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuilding"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Building",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.bldg_pl,
        )
        self.storey_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.bldg_pl)
        self.storey = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuildingStorey",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuildingStorey::DataHall"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Hall",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            Elevation=0.0,
            ObjectPlacement=self.storey_pl,
        )
        self.space_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.storey_pl)
        self.space = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSpace",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSpace::ServerRoom"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Server Room",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            PredefinedType="INTERNAL",
            ObjectPlacement=self.space_pl,
        )

        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Project->Site"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.project,
            RelatedObjects=[self.site],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Site->Building"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.site,
            RelatedObjects=[self.building],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Building->Storey"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.building,
            RelatedObjects=[self.storey],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Storey->Space"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.storey,
            RelatedObjects=[self.space],
        )

    def make_placement(self, x: float, y: float, z: float, axis=None, ref_dir=None, parent=None):
        f = self.f
        pt = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(x), float(y), float(z)))
        ax = axis if axis is not None else self.dir_z
        rf = ref_dir if ref_dir is not None else self.dir_x
        a2p = f.create_entity("IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=pt, Axis=ax, RefDirection=rf)
        return f.create_entity("IfcLocalPlacement", PlacementRelTo=parent, RelativePlacement=a2p)

    def make_box_shape(self, x_dim: float, y_dim: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcRectangleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            XDim=float(x_dim),
            YDim=float(y_dim),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_cylinder_shape(self, radius: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcCircleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            Radius=float(radius),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_polygon_slab_shape(self, pts_2d, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        ifc_pts = [f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(px), float(py))) for px, py in pts_2d]
        ifc_pts.append(ifc_pts[0])
        poly = f.create_entity("IfcPolyline", Points=ifc_pts)
        prof = f.create_entity("IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef", ProfileType="AREA", OuterCurve=poly)
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def add_pset(self, element, pset_name: str, props_dict: dict):
        f = self.f
        prop_entities = []
        for k, v in props_dict.items():
            if isinstance(v, bool):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcBoolean", v)
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcInteger", v)
            elif isinstance(v, float):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcReal", round(float(v), 4))
            else:
                val = f.create_entity("IfcLabel", str(v))
            prop_entities.append(
                f.create_entity("IfcPropertySingleValue", Name=str(k), NominalValue=val)
            )
        pset = f.create_entity(
            "IfcPropertySet",
            GlobalId=make_guid(f"Pset::{element.GlobalId}::{pset_name}"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name=pset_name,
            HasProperties=prop_entities,
        )

import numpy as np
import numpy.typing as npt
import ifcopenshell.api.owner
import ifcopenshell.util.unit
import ifcopenshell.util.element
import ifcopenshell.util.placement
from ifcopenshell.util.shape_builder import ShapeBuilder
from typing import Optional, Union, Any

NPArrayOfFloats = npt.NDArray[np.float64]


def edit_object_placement(
    file: ifcopenshell.file,
    product: ifcopenshell.entity_instance,
    matrix: Optional[NPArrayOfFloats] = None,
    is_si: bool = True,
    should_transform_children: bool = False,
) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
    """Changes the object placement matrix of an element

    The placement matrix is a 4x4 matrix describing the location and
    orientation of an element in 3D. See
    https://docs.ifcopenshell.org/ifcopenshell-python/geometry_creation.html#object-placements
    for more details.

    This only supports local placements. Grid and linear placements are not
    supported.

    :param matrix: A 4x4 matrix in numpy. If left blank, it is the identity
        matrix (equivalent to ``np.eye(4)``).
    :param is_si: If True, the matrix is given in SI units. If false, in
        project units.
    :param should_transform_children: A child element is a nested element,
        opening, filling, etc. If true, child elements will move along with the
        parent. If false, child elements will stay where they are. Because most
        placements in IFC are relative, this means that if a child moves, we
        actually don't change their placement.
    :return: The new or updated IfcLocalPlacement entity
    """
    usecase = Usecase()
    usecase.file = file
    usecase.settings = {
        "product": product,
        "matrix": matrix if matrix is not None else np.eye(4),
        "is_si": is_si,
        "should_transform_children": should_transform_children,
    }
    return usecase.execute()


class Usecase:
    file: ifcopenshell.file
    settings: dict[str, Any]

    def execute(self):
        if not hasattr(self.settings["product"], "ObjectPlacement"):
            return
        self.unit_scale = ifcopenshell.util.unit.calculate_unit_scale(self.file)
        self.builder = ShapeBuilder(self.file)

        if not self.settings["is_si"]:
            self.convert_matrix_to_si(self.settings["matrix"])

        children_settings = []
        if not self.settings["should_transform_children"]:
            children_settings = self.get_children_settings(self.settings["product"].ObjectPlacement)

        placement_rel_to = self.get_placement_rel_to()
        relative_placement = self.get_relative_placement(placement_rel_to)
        new_placement = self.file.createIfcLocalPlacement(RelativePlacement=relative_placement)

        old_placement = self.settings["product"].ObjectPlacement

        if old_placement:
            for inverse in self.file.get_inverse(old_placement):
                if inverse.is_a("IfcLocalPlacement"):
                    ifcopenshell.util.element.replace_attribute(inverse, old_placement, new_placement)

            if self.file.get_total_inverses(old_placement) == 1:
                self.settings["product"].ObjectPlacement = None
                old_placement.PlacementRelTo = None
                ifcopenshell.util.element.remove_deep2(self.file, old_placement)

        new_placement.PlacementRelTo = placement_rel_to
        self.settings["product"].ObjectPlacement = new_placement

        ifcopenshell.api.owner.update_owner_history(self.file, element=self.settings["product"])

        for settings in children_settings:
            self.settings = settings
            self.execute()

        return new_placement

    def convert_matrix_to_si(self, matrix: NPArrayOfFloats):
        matrix[0][3] *= self.unit_scale
        matrix[1][3] *= self.unit_scale
        matrix[2][3] *= self.unit_scale

    def get_placement_rel_to(self) -> Union[ifcopenshell.entity_instance, None]:
        product = self.settings["product"]
        relating_object = None

        if rels := getattr(product, "Decomposes", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatingObject
        elif rels := getattr(product, "Nests", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatingObject
        elif rels := getattr(product, "ContainedIn", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatedElement
        elif rels := getattr(product, "VoidsElements", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatingBuildingElement
        elif rels := getattr(product, "FillsVoids", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatingOpeningElement
        elif rels := getattr(product, "ProjectsElements", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatingElement
        # TODO: add tests when there will be adherence api
        elif rels := getattr(product, "AdheresToElement", None):
            relating_object = rels[0].RelatingElement
        elif rels := getattr(product, "ContainedInStructure", None):
            return rels[0].RelatingStructure.ObjectPlacement

        if relating_object:
            return getattr(relating_object, "ObjectPlacement", None)

    def get_children_settings(self, placement: Union[ifcopenshell.entity_instance, None]) -> list[dict]:
        if not placement:
            return []
        results = []
        # NOTE: we ignore subchildren as we already adjust position for their parent
        # therefore they're not present in `results` and `should_transform_children` should be `True`
        for referenced_placement in placement.ReferencedByPlacements:
            matrix = ifcopenshell.util.placement.get_local_placement(referenced_placement)
            for obj in referenced_placement.PlacesObject:
                if obj.is_a("IfcDistributionPort"):
                    # Although a port is technically a nested child, it is generally
                    # more intuitive that the ports always move with the parent.
                    continue
                elif obj.is_a("IfcFeatureElement"):
                    # Feature elements affect the geometry of their parent, and
                    # so logically should always move with the parent. However,
                    # subchildren (fillings) shouldn't move.
                    placement2 = obj.ObjectPlacement
                    for referenced_placement2 in placement2.ReferencedByPlacements:
                        matrix2 = ifcopenshell.util.placement.get_local_placement(referenced_placement2)
                        for obj2 in referenced_placement2.PlacesObject:
                            results.append(
                                {"product": obj2, "matrix": matrix2, "is_si": False, "should_transform_children": True}
                            )
                    continue
                results.append({"product": obj, "matrix": matrix, "is_si": False, "should_transform_children": True})
        return results

    def get_relative_placement(
        self, placement_rel_to: Union[ifcopenshell.entity_instance, None]
    ) -> ifcopenshell.entity_instance:
        if placement_rel_to:
            relating_object_matrix = ifcopenshell.util.placement.get_local_placement(placement_rel_to)
            relating_object_matrix[0][3] = self.convert_unit_to_si(relating_object_matrix[0][3])
            relating_object_matrix[1][3] = self.convert_unit_to_si(relating_object_matrix[1][3])
            relating_object_matrix[2][3] = self.convert_unit_to_si(relating_object_matrix[2][3])
        else:
            relating_object_matrix = np.eye(4)
        m = self.settings["matrix"]
        x = np.array((m[0][0], m[1][0], m[2][0]))
        z = np.array((m[0][2], m[1][2], m[2][2]))
        o = np.array((m[0][3], m[1][3], m[2][3]))
        object_matrix = ifcopenshell.util.placement.a2p(o, z, x)
        relative_placement_matrix = np.linalg.inv(relating_object_matrix) @ object_matrix
        return self.builder.create_axis2_placement_3d(
            self.convert_si_to_unit(relative_placement_matrix[:, 3][0:3]),
            relative_placement_matrix[:, 2][0:3],
            relative_placement_matrix[:, 0][0:3],
        )

    def convert_si_to_unit(self, co: NPArrayOfFloats) -> NPArrayOfFloats:
        return co / self.unit_scale

    def convert_unit_to_si(self, co: NPArrayOfFloats) -> NPArrayOfFloats:
        return co * self.unit_scale

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IFC4 Model Builder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class HallModelBuilder:
    def __init__(self):
        self.f = ifcopenshell.file(schema="IFC4")
        self._init_header_and_context()
        self.storey_elements = []

    def _init_header_and_context(self):
        f = self.f
        org = f.create_entity("IfcOrganization", Name="MEP Coordination Corp")
        app = f.create_entity(
            "IfcApplication",
            ApplicationDeveloper=org,
            Version="1.0",
            ApplicationFullName="DCM Hall Coordinator",
            ApplicationIdentifier="DCM-COORD",
        )
        person = f.create_entity("IfcPerson", FamilyName="Coordinator", GivenName="BIM")
        p_org = f.create_entity("IfcPersonAndOrganization", ThePerson=person, TheOrganization=org)
        self.owner_history = f.create_entity(
            "IfcOwnerHistory",
            OwningUser=p_org,
            OwningApplication=app,
            ChangeAction="NOCHANGE",
            CreationDate=1700000000,
        )

        # Units: MILLIMETRE
        unit_len = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="LENGTHUNIT", Prefix="MILLI", Name="METRE")
        unit_area = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="AREAUNIT", Name="SQUARE_METRE")
        unit_vol = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="VOLUMEUNIT", Name="CUBIC_METRE")
        unit_angle = f.create_entity("IfcSIUnit", UnitType="PLANEANGLEUNIT", Name="RADIAN")
        unit_assign = f.create_entity("IfcUnitAssignment", Units=[unit_len, unit_area, unit_vol, unit_angle])

        # 3D Context & 2D Origin
        self.origin_3d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.origin_2d = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_z = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0))
        self.dir_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_neg_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(-1.0, 0.0, 0.0))
        self.dir_2d_x = f.create_entity("IfcDirection", DirectionRatios=(1.0, 0.0))

        self.world_cs = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=self.origin_3d, Axis=self.dir_z, RefDirection=self.dir_x
        )
        self.pos_2d = f.create_entity(
            "IfcAxis2Placement2D", Location=self.origin_2d, RefDirection=self.dir_2d_x
        )

        self.context = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Model",
            ContextType="Model",
            CoordinateSpaceDimension=3,
            Precision=1.0e-5,
            WorldCoordinateSystem=self.world_cs,
        )
        self.body_ctx = f.create_entity(
            "IfcGeometricRepresentationSubContext",
            ContextIdentifier="Body",
            ContextType="Model",
            ParentContext=self.context,
            TargetView="MODEL_VIEW",
        )

        self.project = f.create_entity(
            "IfcProject",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcProject"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="hall_seed005_d100",
            Description="Data Hall Overhead MEP Coordination Model",
            RepresentationContexts=[self.context],
            UnitsInContext=unit_assign,
        )

        # Spatial Hierarchy: Project -> Site -> Building -> Storey ("Data Hall") -> Space ("Server Room")
        self.site_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=None)
        self.site = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSite",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSite"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Site",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.site_pl,
        )
        self.bldg_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.site_pl)
        self.building = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuilding",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuilding"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Center Building",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            ObjectPlacement=self.bldg_pl,
        )
        self.storey_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.bldg_pl)
        self.storey = f.create_entity(
            "IfcBuildingStorey",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcBuildingStorey::DataHall"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Data Hall",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            Elevation=0.0,
            ObjectPlacement=self.storey_pl,
        )
        self.space_pl = self.make_placement(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, parent=self.storey_pl)
        self.space = f.create_entity(
            "IfcSpace",
            GlobalId=make_guid("IfcSpace::ServerRoom"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name="Server Room",
            CompositionType="ELEMENT",
            PredefinedType="INTERNAL",
            ObjectPlacement=self.space_pl,
        )

        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Project->Site"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.project,
            RelatedObjects=[self.site],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Site->Building"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.site,
            RelatedObjects=[self.building],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Building->Storey"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.building,
            RelatedObjects=[self.storey],
        )
        f.create_entity(
            "IfcRelAggregates",
            GlobalId=make_guid("RelAgg::Storey->Space"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            RelatingObject=self.storey,
            RelatedObjects=[self.space],
        )

    def make_placement(self, x: float, y: float, z: float, axis=None, ref_dir=None, parent=None):
        f = self.f
        pt = f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(x), float(y), float(z)))
        ax = axis if axis is not None else self.dir_z
        rf = ref_dir if ref_dir is not None else self.dir_x
        a2p = f.create_entity("IfcAxis2Placement3D", Location=pt, Axis=ax, RefDirection=rf)
        return f.create_entity("IfcLocalPlacement", PlacementRelTo=parent, RelativePlacement=a2p)

    def make_box_shape(self, x_dim: float, y_dim: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcRectangleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            XDim=float(x_dim),
            YDim=float(y_dim),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_cylinder_shape(self, radius: float, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        prof = f.create_entity(
            "IfcCircleProfileDef",
            ProfileType="AREA",
            Position=self.pos_2d,
            Radius=float(radius),
        )
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def make_polygon_slab_shape(self, pts_2d, depth: float):
        f = self.f
        ifc_pts = [f.create_entity("IfcCartesianPoint", Coordinates=(float(px), float(py))) for px, py in pts_2d]
        ifc_pts.append(ifc_pts[0])
        poly = f.create_entity("IfcPolyline", Points=ifc_pts)
        prof = f.create_entity("IfcArbitraryClosedProfileDef", ProfileType="AREA", OuterCurve=poly)
        solid = f.create_entity(
            "IfcExtrudedAreaSolid",
            SweptArea=prof,
            Position=self.world_cs,
            ExtrudedDirection=self.dir_z,
            Depth=float(depth),
        )
        rep = f.create_entity(
            "IfcShapeRepresentation",
            ContextOfItems=self.body_ctx,
            RepresentationIdentifier="Body",
            RepresentationType="SweptSolid",
            Items=[solid],
        )
        return f.create_entity("IfcProductDefinitionShape", Representations=[rep])

    def add_pset(self, element, pset_name: str, props_dict: dict):
        f = self.f
        prop_entities = []
        for k, v in props_dict.items():
            if isinstance(v, bool):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcBoolean", v)
            elif isinstance(v, int):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcInteger", v)
            elif isinstance(v, float):
                val = f.create_entity("IfcReal", round(float(v), 4))
            else:
                val = f.create_entity("IfcLabel", str(v))
            prop_entities.append(
                f.create_entity("IfcPropertySingleValue", Name=str(k), NominalValue=val)
            )
        pset = f.create_entity(
            "IfcPropertySet",
            GlobalId=make_guid(f"Pset::{element.GlobalId}::{pset_name}"),
            OwnerHistory=self.owner_history,
            Name=pset_name,
            HasProperties=prop_entities,
        )

I have reconciled the seven architectural and MEP drawing sheets (`A-101`, `A-301`, `A-601`, `A-602`, `M-101`, `E-101`, `F-101`) for `dc_model hall_seed005_d100` and delivered the complete clash-free 3D IFC4 coordination model, generator script, and reconciliation log.

### Delivered Files
1. **`output/solution.py`** — Self-contained, deterministic Python script using `ifcopenshell==0.8.4` and `numpy` (with all drawing coordinates, dimensions, schedules, and route geometry baked in as literals and zero runtime image reading) that writes the IFC4 model to `sys.argv[1]` (default `output/model.ifc`) in `< 1 s`.
2. **`output/model.ifc`** — Validated IFC4 coordination model (`461` `IfcElement` solids) containing the full spatial hierarchy (`IfcProject -> IfcSite -> IfcBuilding -> IfcBuildingStorey ("Data Hall") -> IfcSpace ("Server Room")`), L-shaped room enclosure, structural and access floors, 8 full-height interior columns, 94 server/network cabinets, 16 CRAHs (4 perimeter + 12 in-row), 4 PDUs, cold-aisle containment (`CAC-AB`), 104 sprinkler heads (94 ceiling + 10 sub-containment), 3 service entries, routed overhead MEP pathways (`CT-1`, `BW-1`, `CHW-1`), hangers/supports, and service terminations/taps.
3. **`output/reconciliation.json`** — Side-file log documenting every numeric dimension, grid offset, clearance, and note extracted from the seven drawing sheets and how each was applied.

### Key Coordination & Verification Results
- **IFC4 Schema & EXPRESS Rules Validation**: `0` errors and `0` warnings under `ifcopenshell.validate.validate(..., express_rules=True)`.
- **Zero Hard Clashes**: `0` clashes (`> 2 mm` overlap) across all `461` 3D element solids verified via both `ifcopenshell.geom.tree().clash_intersection_many(..., tolerance=0.002, check_all=True)` and exact 3D mesh bounding-box intersection checks.
- **Grid Conflict & Row Re-Registration**: Reconciled the `7200 mm` structural column grid offset `-150 mm` from the `600 × 600 mm` floor-tile grid (`X, Y ∈ {7050, 14250, 21450} mm`) using `2-tile` (`1200 mm`, `Z-600`) column pockets in Rows B and C to preserve `900 mm` door-swing clearance, and re-registered the East half of every cabinet row after the circulation cross-aisle onto exact tile boundary `X = 12600 mm` (`Tile V`).
- **Disjoint Overhead MEP Tiers & Code Compliance**:
